commits.message:
add workflow-level gate checks to bug-agent-fix and bug-agent-test

The /bug-fix and /bug-tdd agents previously enforced their preconditions
in the LLM prompt, which is bypassable by prompt drift. Restore the same
strength as the pre-conversion yml workflows by validating the gates in a
hand-written `steps:` block that runs before the agent.

Fix gate (bug-agent-fix.md):
- Initial mode: PR body must contain AGENT_TEST_COMPLETE and a prior
  claude[bot] comment with AGENT_REVIEW_VERDICT: TEST_APPROVED.
- Revision mode (AGENT_FIX_COMPLETE present): require a prior claude[bot]
  comment with AGENT_REVIEW_VERDICT: FIX_CHANGES_REQUESTED.

Test gate (bug-agent-test.md):
- Initial mode (issue): require a prior claude[bot] comment with
  AGENT_ANALYSIS_COMPLETE on the issue.
- Revision mode (PR): require AGENT_TEST_COMPLETE in PR body, no
  AGENT_FIX_COMPLETE, and a prior claude[bot] comment with
  AGENT_REVIEW_VERDICT: TEST_CHANGES_REQUESTED.

On gate failure, the step writes the reason to stdout (`::error::`) and
$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY, then exits 1, which aborts the agent job. The
explanatory PR comment from the original yml workflows is dropped because
gh-aw strict mode forbids workflow-level write permissions, and user
`steps:` are placed in the read-only agent job. The user can read the
failure reason on the run page.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.attribution_evidence: Claude Code:claude_anthropic_coauthor

commits.message:
convert bug-agent pipeline to gh-aw agentic workflows

Replace the custom .github/bug-agent-pipeline/ directory and hand-written
workflow YAMLs with gh-aw markdown workflows that compile to .lock.yml files.

Pipeline chain, driven by slash commands on the issue/PR:
- /bug-analyze on an issue -> analyst posts root cause analysis
- /bug-tdd on the issue (or PR for revision) -> test-writer opens draft PR
- reviewer runs automatically on PR open/synchronize for ai-bug-pipeline-*
- /bug-fix on the PR -> fixer implements fix after reviewer approves test

The test-writer and fixer workflows set up Python/uv/pnpm/Node/playwright
via the gh-aw steps field so pytest, pnpm test and playwright can run.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.attribution_evidence: Claude Code:claude_anthropic_coauthor

commits.message:
fix(ci): pin node 24.15.0 in bug-agent workflows (playwright#41000) (#9411)

The bug-agent test/fix workflows hang on `pnpm exec playwright install
chromium`: the download reaches 100% then stalls in finalization until the
job is cancelled (e.g. opsmill run 26745429717 hung ~3h). Root cause is a
Node 24.16+ regression, microsoft/playwright#41000.

Classic CI hit the same issue and pinned node-version: 24.15.0 in #9383
(ci.yml). The bug-agent workflows still floated on node-version: 24 and so
pulled the broken Node. Pin them to 24.15.0 to match.

Verified on a fork: with floating node 24 the install hung >10min; with
24.15.0 it completed in ~10s.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
commits.attribution_evidence: Claude Code:claude_anthropic_coauthor
